Complaint Description: Public toilets in our locality are poorly maintained and maintained in an unhygienic condition. Dirty floors, overflowing dustbins, blocked drainage, unpleasant odors, and a lack of proper water facilities are causing serious inconvenience to the public. These unsanitary conditions may lead to the spread of infections and diseases. Women, children, elderly people, and daily commuters are particularly affected. We request the concerned authorities to take immediate action by cleaning and disinfecting public toilets, ensuring regular water supply, maintaining proper drainage, and providing essential hygiene facilities. Regular inspections and maintenance should be conducted to ensure clean and safe public toilets for everyone.
Resolution Description: The concerned authorities should thoroughly clean and disinfect all public toilets to maintain proper hygiene and sanitation. Blocked drainage systems should be repaired, overflowing dustbins should be cleared, and adequate water supply and essential hygiene facilities should be ensured. Regular cleaning schedules, proper waste disposal, and frequent inspections should be implemented to maintain clean, safe, and hygienic public toilet facilities for everyone.
Citizen Feedback: We appreciate the authorities for taking prompt action to improve the cleanliness and hygiene of public toilets. The cleaning, disinfection, proper water supply, and waste management measures have made the facilities more convenient and hygienic for the public. We request regular maintenance and inspections to ensure that public toilets remain clean, safe, and accessible for everyone.

Complaint Description: Open urination in public places, street corners, and roadside areas has become a serious sanitation issue in our locality. It creates unpleasant smells, unhygienic conditions, and health concerns for residents and pedestrians. The problem also affects the cleanliness and appearance of public spaces. We request the concerned authorities to take immediate action by installing adequate public toilet facilities, maintaining proper sanitation, placing awareness boards, and enforcing rules to discourage public urination. Regular cleaning and monitoring should be carried out to maintain a clean and hygienic environment.
Resolution Description: The concerned authorities should clean and disinfect the affected public areas to eliminate unpleasant odors and maintain proper hygiene. Adequate public toilet facilities should be provided and regularly maintained. Awareness boards should be installed to discourage open urination, and necessary fines should be imposed on violators. Regular sanitation inspections and maintenance should be conducted to ensure a clean, hygienic, and healthy environment for residents.
Citizen Feedback: We appreciate the authorities for taking action to address the open urination problem and improve public sanitation. The cleaning of affected areas and provision of proper toilet facilities have helped maintain a cleaner and healthier environment. We request regular cleaning, proper maintenance of public toilets, and continued monitoring to prevent this issue from recurring.

Complaint Description: Stray cattle are frequently roaming and resting on roads in our locality, creating serious safety concerns for motorists and pedestrians. Their presence obstructs traffic movement, causes congestion, and increases the risk of road accidents, especially during nighttime. Cattle wandering near busy junctions also create difficulties for two-wheeler riders and public transport. We request the concerned authorities to take immediate action by safely relocating stray cattle, identifying their owners, and implementing proper monitoring measures to keep roads clear and ensure public safety.
Resolution Description: The concerned authorities should identify and safely relocate stray cattle found roaming on public roads. Cattle owners should be identified and warned against allowing their animals to wander freely. Necessary fines and legal actions should be taken against repeated violations. Regular monitoring and proper cattle management measures should be implemented to prevent road obstructions, reduce accidents, and ensure the safety of pedestrians and motorists.
Citizen Feedback: We appreciate the authorities for taking prompt action to remove stray cattle from public roads and improve road safety. These measures have helped reduce traffic obstructions and the risk of accidents. We request regular monitoring and strict action against cattle owners who allow their animals to roam freely on roads.

Complaint Description: A large number of stray dogs are roaming around our locality, creating difficulties and safety concerns for residents. They frequently chase pedestrians, bark aggressively, and cause disturbances, especially during nighttime. Children, elderly people, and two-wheeler riders are at risk of dog bites and accidents. We request the concerned authorities to take appropriate action by arranging safe dog-catching and animal birth control measures, providing anti-rabies vaccinations, and ensuring proper management of stray dogs to maintain public safety and prevent further incidents.
Resolution Description: The concerned authorities should conduct an inspection of the affected areas and take appropriate measures to manage the stray dog population. Animal birth control procedures, anti-rabies vaccinations, and health checkups should be arranged through authorized veterinary teams. Aggressive or injured dogs should receive proper veterinary care. Regular monitoring and responsible animal management practices should be implemented to ensure public safety while protecting animal welfare.
Citizen Feedback: We appreciate the authorities for taking appropriate action to address the stray dog menace in our locality. The vaccination, sterilization, and proper management measures have improved public safety and reduced residents' concerns. We request regular monitoring and continued animal welfare initiatives to maintain a safe environment for both residents and animals.

Complaint Description: Stagnant water in open drains, potholes, and waste-filled areas in our locality has become a major breeding ground for mosquitoes. This creates unhealthy living conditions and increases the risk of mosquito-borne diseases such as dengue and malaria. The issue is causing concern among residents, especially children and elderly people. We request the concerned authorities to take immediate action by clearing stagnant water, cleaning drainage systems, spraying mosquito-control chemicals, and conducting regular inspections to prevent mosquito breeding and protect public health.
Resolution Description: The concerned authorities should remove stagnant water from open drains, potholes, and other affected areas to eliminate mosquito breeding sites. Proper drainage cleaning, waste removal, and mosquito-control measures such as fogging and larvicide spraying should be carried out. Regular sanitation inspections and preventive measures should be implemented to control mosquito populations and protect public health.
Citizen Feedback: We appreciate the authorities for taking necessary steps to control mosquito breeding and improve sanitation in our locality. The removal of stagnant water, cleaning of drains, and mosquito-control measures have helped create a healthier environment. We request regular inspections and preventive actions to avoid mosquito breeding and protect residents from mosquito-borne diseases.
